About.title: Fullstack developer who likes shipping real things
About.p1: I'm Huy, a Software Engineering graduate from Can Tho University with a GPA of 3.55/4.0. Over the past 1.5 years, I've had the opportunity to work across different environments, contributing to real-world products including websites for international dental clinics, internal management dashboards, AI-integrated platforms, and ERP modules built on Odoo.
About.p2: I have a strong interest in performance optimization, user experience, and building reusable, maintainable component systems. Technically, I'm comfortable working across the entire stack—from React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend, to NestJS and PostgreSQL on the backend, as well as developing ERP solutions using Python and Odoo.
About.p3: Beyond work, I enjoy documenting and sharing what I learn through personal technical notes and articles. I'm also eager to explore new tools and approaches that improve productivity while maintaining a strong focus on quality, attention to detail, and craftsmanship.
